```{r}
augmented_modeling_function = function(dataset,
                                       target,
                                       k_folds,
                                       model_type,
                                       lower_thresh = 0,
                                       upper_thresh = 251){
  
  dataset = dataset %>% filter(Conc. > lower_thresh & Conc. < upper_thresh)
  concentrations = dataset$Conc.
  
   gen_rec = recipe(target_vector~., data = dataset) %>%
      update_role(SampleNum, Conc., new_role = 'id') # %>%
      # step_umap(neighbors = 30, keep_original_cols = FALSE)
   
  # gen_rec = recipe(target_vector~., data = dataset) %>% 
    # update_role(SampleNum, Conc., new_role = 'id') # %>% 
    # step_umap(neighbors = 30, keep_original_cols = T)
    # step_BoxCox(all_predictors()) %>% 
    # step_normalize(Conc.)

  folds = vfold_cv(dataset, v=k_folds, repeats = 2, strata = target_vector)
  
  if (model_type == 'rbf_svm'){
    mod = svm_rbf(cost = tune(), rbf_sigma = tune()) %>% 
    set_mode('classification') %>% 
    set_engine('kernlab')
    
    gen_rec = gen_rec %>% step_normalize(all_predictors())
    
    params = extract_parameter_set_dials(mod)
    param_grid = grid_latin_hypercube(params,
                                      size = 30)
  }
  
  if (model_type == 'rf'){
    mod = rand_forest(trees = 5000, mtry = tune(), min_n = tune()) %>% 
      set_mode('classification') %>% 
      set_engine('ranger')
    
    params = extract_parameter_set_dials(mod) %>% finalize(x = dataset %>% select(-c(target_vector, SampleNum, Conc.)))
    param_grid = grid_latin_hypercube(params,
                                      size = 20)
  }
  
  resample_results = mod %>%
      tune_grid(
        gen_rec,
        resamples = folds,
        grid = param_grid,
        control = control_grid(save_pred = TRUE)
      )
  
  metrics = collect_metrics(resample_results)

  return(list("resample_results" = resample_results,
              "concentrations" = concentrations))
}
```

```{r}
collect_best_predictions = function(model_results){
  best_params = show_best(model_results, metric = 'roc_auc')
  
  best_param_preds = collect_predictions(model_results, parameters = best_params[1,])
  
  best_param_preds_rows = best_param_preds$.row
  
  best_param_probs = data.frame('Beta' = best_param_preds$.pred_Beta,
                              'Delta' = best_param_preds$.pred_Delta,
                              'Omicron' = best_param_preds$.pred_Omicron,
                              'WT' = best_param_preds$.pred_WT)
  
  max_diff = function(x){
    vec = sort(unlist(x, use.names = F), decreasing = T)
    diff = vec[1]-vec[2]
  return(diff)
  }
  
  max_diff = apply(best_param_probs, 1, max_diff)
  max_prob = apply(best_param_probs, 1, function(x) paste0(names(best_param_probs)[x==max(x)]))
  best_param_probs$max_diff = max_diff
  best_param_probs$max_prob = max_prob
  
  best_param_probs$true_class = best_param_preds$target_vector
  best_param_probs$correct = ifelse(best_param_probs$max_prob == best_param_probs$true_class, 1, 0)
  best_param_probs$concentration = model_results$concentrations
  
  sum(best_param_probs$max_prob == best_param_preds$target_vector)/nrow(best_param_probs)

  # Now I could see what the average difference is in probability between the max probability value and the second highest value. Ideally, i would see this
  # increase as a function of increasing concentration
  # Concentration values are obtained from the modeled dataset after concentration bounds
  correct_preds = best_param_probs %>% filter(correct == 1) %>% reframe(mean = mean(max_diff),
                                                        median = median(max_diff),
                                                        sd = sd(max_diff)) %>% print()
  incorrect_preds = best_param_probs %>% filter(correct == 0) %>% reframe(mean = mean(max_diff),
                                                        median = median(max_diff),
                                                        sd = sd(max_diff)) %>% print()
  
  accuracy = sum(best_param_probs$max_prob == best_param_preds$target_vector)/nrow(best_param_probs)
  print(paste0("Accuracy: ", accuracy))
  return(list("Accuracy" = accuracy,
              "best_param_probs" = best_param_probs,
              "correct_preds" = correct_preds,
              "incorrect_preds" = incorrect_preds,
              "best_param_preds_rows" = best_param_preds_rows))
}

analyze_confidence = function(probability_df,
                              concentration_values,
                              prediction_row,
                              high_conf_thresh=0.5,
                              low_conf_thresh=0.5){
  probability_df$concentration = concentration_values[prediction_row]
  max_diff_mean = mean(probability_df$max_diff)
  max_diff_sd = sd(probability_df$max_diff)
  
  probability_df = probability_df %>% mutate(
  confidence = case_when(
    max_diff > max_diff_mean + high_conf_thresh * max_diff_sd ~ "High",
    max_diff < max_diff_mean - low_conf_thresh * max_diff_sd ~ "Low",
    .default = 'Medium'
    )
  )
  probability_df$rowNum = prediction_row
  
  print(probability_df %>% group_by(confidence) %>% count(correct))

  print(probability_df %>% group_by(confidence) %>% summarize(mean_conc = mean(concentration),
                                                        sd_conc = sd(concentration)))
  p = ggplot(probability_df, aes(x=concentration))+
    geom_histogram()+
    scale_x_log10()+
    facet_wrap(facets = 'confidence')
  
  print(p)
  
  return(probability_df)
}
```

```{r}
# Augmented modeling function with bayesian optimization + Xgboost results
augmented_xgb_modeling_function = function(dataset,
                                       target,
                                       k_folds,
                                       lower_thresh = 0,
                                       upper_thresh = 251){
  
  dataset = dataset %>% filter(Conc. > lower_thresh & Conc. < upper_thresh)
  concentrations = dataset$Conc.
  
  gen_rec = recipe(target_vector~., data = dataset) %>%
    update_role(SampleNum, Conc., new_role = 'id') %>%
    # step_YeoJohnson(all_predictors()) %>% 
    # step_BoxCox(all_predictors()) %>% 
    # step_normalize(all_predictors())
  
  # gen_rec = recipe(target_vector~., data = dataset) %>% 
  #   update_role(SampleNum, new_role = 'id') %>% 
  #   # update_role(SampleNum, Conc., new_role = 'id') %>% 
  #   step_normalize(Conc.)

  folds = vfold_cv(dataset, v=5, repeats = 2, strata = target_vector)
  
  xgb_model = boost_tree(
    trees = tune(),
    learn_rate = tune(),
    tree_depth = tune(),
    min_n = tune(),
    loss_reduction = tune(),
    sample_size = tune(),
    mtry = tune()
  ) %>% 
    set_mode('classification') %>% 
    set_engine("xgboost", nthread = 6)
  
  xgb_workflow = workflow() %>% add_recipe(gen_rec) %>% add_model(xgb_model)
  
  xgb_params = parameters(
    trees(), learn_rate(),
    tree_depth(), min_n(),
    loss_reduction(),
    sample_size = sample_prop(), finalize(mtry(), dataset)
  )
  
  xgb_params = xgb_params %>% update(trees = trees(c(250, 500)))
  
  xgb_resample = xgb_workflow %>% 
    tune_bayes(
      resamples = folds,
      param_info = xgb_params,
      iter = 30,
      metrics = metric_set(accuracy, roc_auc),
      control = control_bayes(no_improve = 10,
                              save_pred = T)
    )
  
  metrics = collect_metrics(xgb_resample)
  print(metrics)
  return(list("resample_results" = xgb_resample,
              "concentrations" = concentrations))
}
```

```{r}
two_step_xgb_tune = function(dataset,
                             upper_thresh = 251,
                             lower_thresh = 0.1){
  
  dataset = dataset %>% filter(Conc. > lower_thresh & Conc. < upper_thresh)
  concentrations = dataset$Conc.
  
  gen_rec = recipe(target_vector~., data = dataset) %>% 
    update_role(SampleNum, Conc., new_role = 'id') %>% 
    step_YeoJohnson(all_predictors()) %>% 
    step_classdist(class = "target_vector") %>% 
    step_pca()
    # step_normalize(all_predictors())

  xgb_folds = vfold_cv(dataset, v=5, repeats = 2, strata = target_vector)
  
  xgb_mod_stage1 = boost_tree(
    mode = "classification",
    engine = "xgboost",
    learn_rate = tune()
  )
  
  grid_stage_1 = grid_random(
    learn_rate(),
    size= 20
  )
  
  xgb_stage1_wf = workflow() %>% 
    add_model(xgb_mod_stage1) %>% 
    add_recipe(gen_rec)
  
  xgb_tune_stage_1 = tune_grid(
    xgb_stage1_wf,
    resamples = xgb_folds,
    grid = grid_stage_1,
    metrics = metric_set(roc_auc, accuracy),
    control = control_grid(save_pred = TRUE)
  )
  print(xgb_tune_stage_1)

  best_params_stage_1 = xgb_tune_stage_1 %>% 
    collect_metrics() %>% 
    arrange(-mean) %>% 
    slice_head(n=1)
  
  xgb_mod_stage2 = xgb_mod_stage1 %>% 
    set_args(
      learn_rate = best_params_stage_1$learn_rate,
      trees = tune(),
      tree_depth = tune(),
      min_n = tune(),
      loss_reduction = tune(),
      sample_size = tune(),
      mtry = tune()
    )
  
  xgb_tune_stage_2 = xgb_stage1_wf %>% 
    update_model(xgb_mod_stage2)
  
  # Define stage 2 grid
  params_stage_2 = parameters(
    trees(),
    tree_depth(), min_n(),
    loss_reduction(),
    sample_size = sample_prop(), finalize(mtry(), dataset)
  )
  
  params_stage_2 = params_stage_2 %>% update(trees = trees(c(250, 500)))

  bayes_tune_stage_2 = xgb_tune_stage_2 %>% 
    tune_bayes(
      resamples = xgb_folds,
      param_info = params_stage_2,
      iter = 30,
      metrics = metric_set(accuracy, roc_auc),
      control = control_bayes(no_improve = 10,
                              save_pred = T)
    )
  
  metrics = collect_metrics(bayes_tune_stage_2)
  print(metrics)
  return(list("resample_results" = bayes_tune_stage_2,
              "concentrations" = concentrations))
}
```

```{r}
# This is a sort of poor method for identifying outliers anyway, since it can't really
# be applied to new data based on parameters estimated on training data
# i.e., since I don't know the concentration of a test observation, I can't compare it 
# to the same distribution as I'm comparing these to, so I'd never be able to predict 
test_func = function(vec,
                     sample_num){
  # vec = unlist(vec)
  grubbs = grubbs.test(vec, type = 10)
  outlier_position = str_split_i(string = test_grubbs$alternative, pattern = " +", i = 1)
  max_val = max(vec)
  min_val = min(vec)
  
  if (grubbs$p.value < 0.10){
    print(paste0(outlier_position, " outlier detected"))
    
    if (outlier_position == 'higher'){
      vec[[vec==max_val]] = 'NA'
    }
    
    if (outlier_position == 'lower'){
      vec[[vec==min_val]] = 'NA'
    }
    print(vec)
  }
  
  return(data.frame("fluorescence" = vec,
                    'sample_num' = sample_num))
}
```

```{r}
    rename(penalty = lambda)
}

parsnip_ctrl = control_grid(extract = get_glmnet_coefs)

glmnet_res = conc_glm_workflow %>% 
  tune_grid(
    resamples = bootstrap_train,
    grid = grid,
    control = parsnip_ctrl
)
glmnet_res

glmnet_res$.extracts[[1]]$.extracts[[1]] %>% head()

conc_test_preds = predict(glm_wf_fit, conc_testing_data)

conc_test_results = data.frame('preds' = conc_test_preds$.pred,
                               "true" = conc_testing_data$Conc.,
                               'Perc_error' = ((conc_test_preds$.pred-conc_testing_data$Conc.)/conc_testing_data$Conc.)*100
                               )

conc_test_results %>% metrics(truth = true, estimate = preds)

conc_test_results %>% filter(true < 1E6 & true > 1e-10) %>% ggplot(aes(x=true, y=Perc_error)) +
  geom_point()
```
